questions.cardText:
[Earth Science] What is the term for the point where two or more bodies of water meet?
A. Delta
B. Estuary
C. Confluence
Answer: C.
questions.en: What is the term for the point where two or more rivers or streams meet and join into one channel?
questions.de: Wie nennt man die Stelle, an der zwei oder mehr Flüsse oder Bäche zusammentreffen und sich zu einem Gerinne vereinen?

timeline.labelEn: The word 'confluence' enters late Middle English, from Latin cōnfluentia, 'a flowing together'
timeline.labelDe: Das Wort „confluence“ gelangt ins Spätmittelenglische, von lateinisch cōnfluentia, „Zusammenfließen“

questions.notes: The card says 'bodies of water'; a confluence is specifically where watercourses (rivers, streams) join — the question names them to rule out an estuary (river meets sea). German also 'Konfluenz'.

questions.cardText:
[Psychology] “Cognitive behavioral therapy” (CBT) is a form of psychotherapy that focuses on:
A. Uncovering repressed memories from childhood
B. Modifying dysfunctional thoughts and behaviors
C. Improving relationships through communication
Answer: B. CBT has been shown effective not only for mental health disorders but also for helping individuals manage chronic physical symptoms, such as pain.
questions.en: What does cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) focus on modifying?
questions.de: Worauf zielt die kognitive Verhaltenstherapie (KVT) ab, was soll sie verändern?

timeline.labelEn: Aaron Beck develops cognitive therapy, a root of cognitive behavioral therapy
timeline.labelDe: Aaron Beck entwickelt die kognitive Therapie, eine Wurzel der kognitiven Verhaltenstherapie
